item.title: AI-Assisted HTTP Terminator Finds Novel HTTP Desync Techniques and Apache Zero-Day
item.summary: PortSwigger says HTTP Terminator, an artificial intelligence (AI)-assisted research system built by James Kettle, generated and proved new HTTP desynchronization techniques after exploring 30,000 candidate desync vectors.
